notes.title: New Patch Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722259/b1d31100c8dc9089face7c2449784d8f3cf5feb7.jpg[/img]

Our latest update brings a host of thrilling enhancements and content additions:

[b]Toggle Enemy BS Animation[/b]
•	Now, the enemy battle sequence animation is switched off for faster, smoother gameplay experience!

[b]DLC Expansion[/b]
•	If purchased, Nichole's Home Brew is now available in all maps of the free DLC "To Danse with Ravenous Shadows".

[b]Expand your Brain[/b]
•	Customize your character even further with increased perk tree capacity from 30 to 36, offering more freedom in skill development.

[b]Introducing - New Perks that unlock three new ally companions.[/b]
•	Barbarian Battle Buddy
If there is room in your party, a mighty Barbarian joins you in battle! Uses a Battleaxe, Bull Rush, Fart Escape.

•	Amazing Wizard's Apprentice
If there is room in your party, a powerful Wizard joins you in battle! Using a Staff, Gravity Bomb, Bubble Shield, and a Bullshit Power.

•	Tactical Tree Hugger
If there is room in your party, a crafty Ranger joins you in battle! Uses Bow & Daggers, Drones, Snowball Turrets.

[b]Optimizations & Balancing[/b]
•	Enjoy smoother gameplay with several bug fixes, optimizations, and balance improvements for a better, more refined experience!
•	DLC update: Nichole’s Horns are now unlocked correctly when all chapters are completed with two Brews active.
•	Issues that caused loss of progress were fixed.

notes.title: Two New DLCs for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Available Today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722259/d14e7bd6c4eb5e6fd026f5a549df9d1e81a003dd.png[/img]

[h2]Two New DLCs for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Available Today on All Platforms[/h2]

Vienna, Austria - October 23, 2024: THQ Nordic is excited to announce the release of two new DLCs for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! - Nichole's Home Brew and Good Times with Weapons - Weapon Variation Pack. Available now on Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series S|X, and PC. Watch both trailers now:

Nicole's Home Brew: https://youtu.be/xGjfPZAfMV0
Good Times with Weapons - Weapon Variation Pack: https://youtu.be/MWPeiwqwoIg

[b]Nicole's Home Brew[/b]
Nichole’s Infernal Pacts were just the beginning! The Board Girls have unleashed diabolical new Home Brew rules for Snow Day, featuring game-altering modes like The Floor is Lava, Air Superiority, and Super Pissed Off. These brutal challenges will push you to your limit. Your gear? Useless. Your strategies? Obsolete. Adapt fast or fail. Conquer all five new modes and unlock even crazier rule combinations to prove you’re the one and only New Kid. Are you ready?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223240

[b]Good Times with Weapons - Weapon Variation Pack[/b]
Harness the power of speed and stealth and follow the path of the Ninja with the all-new Ninja Stars ranged weapon variation. Strike quickly with a decisive burst of projectiles and vanish back into the shadows, for the life of a Ninja is complex and full of peril. This DLC features an all-new weapon variation of the Wand: the Ninja Star ranged weapon. It also includes three brand-new upgrade cards and new cosmetics.
[list]
[*] Hat: Ninja Hat
[*] Facial Features: Ninja Mask
[*] Tunic: Ninja Tunic
[*] Hat: You're a dog!
[*] Facial Features: Ninja Star to the Eye
[*] Emote: Ninja Star Emote
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126400

Both DLCs are part of the Season Pass and the Digital Deluxe Edition
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717700/SOUTH_PARK_SNOW_DAY__Season_Pass/
https://store.steampowered.com/sub/976991/

SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY!, developed by Question and published by THQ Nordic GmbH in cooperation with South Park Digital Studios, is available now. The Standard Edition of the game is available at an SRP of € 29.99 / $ 29.99 / £ 24.99. The Digital Deluxe Edition is available at an SRP of $49.99 / €49.99 / £39.99. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1214650/SOUTH_PARK_SNOW_DAY/

Enjoy & stay tuned!

[*] Collision issues were fixed.

[*] Cosmetic: Skinny Cartman hat was added.
[/list]

notes.title: First update for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! going live today
notes.content:
The patch addresses various issues across all platforms. Please find the details for PC below:

[list]
[*] Fixed some stability issues.
[*] Fixed a visual glitch of Henrietta in Kupa Keep for clients.
[*] Optimized and fixed some issues for Danse with Ravenous Shadows.
[*] Fixed some collision issues.
[*] Fixed some AI issues.
[/list]

In addition to the above, we are working on another update with fixes and improvements for all platforms and are aiming for a release in April.

For answers to some commonly asked questions, please visit the FAQ at the bottom of this page: 
https://southpark.thqnordic.com/


If you encounter any bugs while playing, please report them via our community bug database: 
https://bugreporting.thqnordic.com/#/projects/140/south-park-snow-day-community/add-issue


Detailed bug reporting instructions can be found in the following Steam thread: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1214650/discussions/1/4299322040761896428/
